newsitems.title: 50,000 wishlists! Join us on Discord
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Hi everyone! No Asteroids has reached 50,000 wishlists on Steam. Thank you! Whether you’ve played the demo, shared the game with a friend, or sent us feedback — thank you for helping the game get here. We’ve also set up a Discord server for No Asteroids. Come chat about the game, share screenshots, report bugs, or tell us what you think. We’re there too, and we’d love to hear from you. 👉 Join the No Asteroids Discord Thanks again for being here! Unruled Games Team

newsitems.title: 25,000 wishlists! Thank you so much for your support!
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Hi everyone, No Asteroids has reached 25,000 wishlists. Thank you for adding the game and sharing it with your friends! Thank you also to everyone playing the demo and sending feedback. Your bug reports help us get the game ready for release. https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/46669689/3cebfe913315cfac6981f3296e9bdceef2ed9f49.gif The full game comes out on November 24. If you want to try it before then, the free demo is available now on Steam.

newsitems.title: The No Asteroids demo now supports controllers
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: Grab a controller and take a shift on the asteroid. You can swing your pickaxe with the right trigger, then head back to the ship and use the right stick to sell your haul at the trade terminal. Open the gamepad settings to adjust stick sensitivity, invert the vertical look axis, or toggle rumble. We’d love to hear how your first shift feels. Which controller did you use? If a button prompt was confusing or you reached for the mouse, tell us where it happened.

newsitems.title: The No Asteroids demo is out now
newsitems.author: Unruled Games
newsitems.contents: The free No Asteroids demo is available now! Five million cubic metres of asteroid are heading for Earth. You have a pickaxe, a spaceship, and a job to do. Play the first 15 days: mine the asteroid, sell what you bring back, upgrade your equipment, and explore your ship between shifts. Your save carries over to the full game on the same computer. The demo is available for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs. Download it from the Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527800/No_Asteroids/ The full game launches November 24. Add No Asteroids to your wishlist if you would like to keep going. I would love to hear how your first shifts go. Leave your feedback or report a bug in the Steam discussions — thank you for playing!
